## Claim protocol — read before you start

This is a device work package. One agent works one device for a sustained
session (hours), not a single micro-task. Claim it with a comment:

```
CLAIM <agent-id> <provider> <UTC ISO-8601 timestamp>
```

Re-read the comments; the first valid claim wins. If yours is not first, comment
`RELEASE <agent-id> conflict` and pick another device. One agent holds one device
package at a time in this repository, on any provider or harness.

A claim holds a 4-hour lease, refreshed by any later comment from the claimant;
an expired claim is revoked by the lead with `REVOKE <slot> <issue#> <reason>`
and returns to the shard pool. Finish with `DONE <remote-sha> <one-line result>` after
pushing (Rule 3).

## Ownership (primary guard)

```
shard(issue) = issue_number % 6
```

| shard | owner |
|---|---|
| 0 | OC-1 |
| 1 | OC-2 |
| 2 | OC-3 |
| 3 | OC-4 |
| 4 | ZC-1 |
| 5 | ZC-2 |

Work only issues in your shard, or in a shard the lead reassigned to you with
`SHARD-REASSIGN <shard> -> <slot>[,<slot>...]` on issue #379. `area:` labels
describe the work; they do not grant ownership.

## GATE -1 — SEARCH THE WHOLE REPO AND THE WHOLE INTERNET (MANDATORY)

Picking an issue is not permission to start. Before the first file edit, post one
comment recording BOTH searches:

```
SEARCH <slot>
repo: <exact commands> -> <paths/shas, or "none">
web: <exact queries + date> -> <urls, or "none">
verdict: NEW | DELTA <one line> | DONE <path> <sha>
```

Repo search covers the whole checkout, not just the obvious directory:

- `git log --all --oneline -- <deliverable path>`
- `git log -S "<distinctive term>" --oneline`
- `grep -rn "<distinctive term>" . --include='*.md' --include='*.py' --include='*.c' --include='*.csv'`
- `docs/REPO-STATE-MAP.md` for the per-family verdict

Web search covers GitHub code (excluding `adineo-cmd/*`), XDA, LWN, HN, Reddit,
arXiv/Scholar, kernel source and linux-firmware.

- `DONE` -> close as ALREADY-DONE, do not work.
- `DELTA` -> work only the delta.
- `NEW` -> proceed.

No SEARCH comment, no work. A commit without one is a protocol violation.

## Discipline (all packages)

- RULE 0: search the web and GitHub code FIRST, record exact query strings and
  dates. Prior art found means find the delta or pick another device.
- RULE 1: fix stale counts, dangling links and broken references in the same
  session, respecting file walls; list before/after.
- Facts-not-blobs: never commit a proprietary payload. Hashes, sizes, offsets,
  counts and <=16-byte hex samples only.
- Standard-library Python only, run with `python3 -I`, no comments in code.
- Every number verified by command output before it is written.
- Honest negatives are deliverables. Report them; do not omit them.
- Push everything when done (Rule 3): verify, commit, fetch and rebase, push to
  `feat/open-device-site`, never force-push, never push `main`. A finished
  package with no remote commit is not done. Exception: issue #143 stays local.

## Device
**ADT_3** — type `devkit`, build variant `atv`, SoC `Amlogic S905Y2`.
Matrix rows: **0**. Upstream count: **8**. State: **count_known**.

## Why this device
Non-phone device: required for the site's every-device-class scope (TV boxes, SBCs, devkits, tablets).

## Deliverable
A device census note under `research/devices/ADT_3.md` plus any recovered per-file CSV.

## Work checklist (work the whole device in one sustained session)
- [ ] Attempt per-file population from a public LineageOS package; upstream count.csv records 8 blobs. Report the delta or an honest negative.
- [ ] Verify type=devkit, build_variant=atv against hardware evidence (type means hardware, not image).
- [ ] Confirm SoC/codename `Amlogic S905Y2` from the inventory and correct it with file:line evidence if wrong.
- [ ] Run RULE 0 prior-art search before any uniqueness claim; record queries and dates.
- [ ] Fix any stale count, dangling link or broken reference found (RULE 1); list before/after.
- [ ] Push the completed package (Rule 3) and report the remote SHA.
title: Device package: ADT_3 (devkit, atv) — 0 matrix rows, 8 upstream blobs

This is a device work package. One agent works one device for a sustained
session (hours), not a single micro-task. Claim it with a comment:

```
CLAIM <agent-id> <provider> <UTC ISO-8601 timestamp>
```

Re-read the comments; the first valid claim wins. If yours is not first, comment
`RELEASE <agent-id> conflict` and pick another device. One agent holds one device
package at a time in this repository, on any provider or harness.

A claim holds a 4-hour lease, refreshed by any later comment from the claimant;
an expired claim is revoked by the lead with `REVOKE <slot> <issue#> <reason>`
and returns to the shard pool. Finish with `DONE <remote-sha> <one-line result>` after
pushing (Rule 3).

## Ownership (primary guard)

```
shard(issue) = issue_number % 6
```

| shard | owner |
|---|---|
| 0 | OC-1 |
| 1 | OC-2 |
| 2 | OC-3 |
| 3 | OC-4 |
| 4 | ZC-1 |
| 5 | ZC-2 |

Work only issues in your shard, or in a shard the lead reassigned to you with
`SHARD-REASSIGN <shard> -> <slot>[,<slot>...]` on issue #379. `area:` labels
describe the work; they do not grant ownership.

## GATE -1 — SEARCH THE WHOLE REPO AND THE WHOLE INTERNET (MANDATORY)

Picking an issue is not permission to start. Before the first file edit, post one
comment recording BOTH searches:

```
SEARCH <slot>
repo: <exact commands> -> <paths/shas, or "none">
web: <exact queries + date> -> <urls, or "none">
verdict: NEW | DELTA <one line> | DONE <path> <sha>
```

Repo search covers the whole checkout, not just the obvious directory:

- `git log --all --oneline -- <deliverable path>`
- `git log -S "<distinctive term>" --oneline`
- `grep -rn "<distinctive term>" . --include='*.md' --include='*.py' --include='*.c' --include='*.csv'`
- `docs/REPO-STATE-MAP.md` for the per-family verdict

Web search covers GitHub code (excluding `adineo-cmd/*`), XDA, LWN, HN, Reddit,
arXiv/Scholar, kernel source and linux-firmware.

- `DONE` -> close as ALREADY-DONE, do not work.
- `DELTA` -> work only the delta.
- `NEW` -> proceed.

No SEARCH comment, no work. A commit without one is a protocol violation.

## Discipline (all packages)

- RULE 0: search the web and GitHub code FIRST, record exact query strings and
  dates. Prior art found means find the delta or pick another device.
- RULE 1: fix stale counts, dangling links and broken references in the same
  session, respecting file walls; list before/after.
- Facts-not-blobs: never commit a proprietary payload. Hashes, sizes, offsets,
  counts and <=16-byte hex samples only.
- Standard-library Python only, run with `python3 -I`, no comments in code.
- Every number verified by command output before it is written.
- Honest negatives are deliverables. Report them; do not omit them.
- Push everything when done (Rule 3): verify, commit, fetch and rebase, push to
  `feat/open-device-site`, never force-push, never push `main`. A finished
  package with no remote commit is not done. Exception: issue #143 stays local.

## Device
**TX1_TV** — type `devkit`, build variant `atv`, SoC `foster`.
Matrix rows: **0**. Upstream count: **33**. State: **count_known**.

## Why this device
Non-phone device: required for the site's every-device-class scope (TV boxes, SBCs, devkits, tablets).

## Deliverable
A device census note under `research/devices/TX1_TV.md` plus any recovered per-file CSV.

## Work checklist (work the whole device in one sustained session)
- [ ] Attempt per-file population from a public LineageOS package; upstream count.csv records 33 blobs. Report the delta or an honest negative.
- [ ] Verify type=devkit, build_variant=atv against hardware evidence (type means hardware, not image).
- [ ] Confirm SoC/codename `codename foster` from the inventory and correct it with file:line evidence if wrong.
- [ ] Run RULE 0 prior-art search before any uniqueness claim; record queries and dates.
- [ ] Fix any stale count, dangling link or broken reference found (RULE 1); list before/after.
- [ ] Push the completed package (Rule 3) and report the remote SHA.
title: Device package: TX1_TV (devkit, atv) — 0 matrix rows, 33 upstream blobs


This is a device work package. One agent works one device for a sustained
session (hours), not a single micro-task. Claim it with a comment:

```
CLAIM <agent-id> <provider> <UTC ISO-8601 timestamp>
```

Re-read the comments; the first valid claim wins. If yours is not first, comment
`RELEASE <agent-id> conflict` and pick another device. One agent holds one device
package at a time in this repository, on any provider or harness.

A claim holds a 4-hour lease, refreshed by any later comment from the claimant;
an expired claim is revoked by the lead with `REVOKE <slot> <issue#> <reason>`
and returns to the shard pool. Finish with `DONE <remote-sha> <one-line result>` after
pushing (Rule 3).

## Ownership (primary guard)

```
shard(issue) = issue_number % 6
```

| shard | owner |
|---|---|
| 0 | OC-1 |
| 1 | OC-2 |
| 2 | OC-3 |
| 3 | OC-4 |
| 4 | ZC-1 |
| 5 | ZC-2 |

Work only issues in your shard, or in a shard the lead reassigned to you with
`SHARD-REASSIGN <shard> -> <slot>[,<slot>...]` on issue #379. `area:` labels
describe the work; they do not grant ownership.

## GATE -1 — SEARCH THE WHOLE REPO AND THE WHOLE INTERNET (MANDATORY)

Picking an issue is not permission to start. Before the first file edit, post one
comment recording BOTH searches:

```
SEARCH <slot>
repo: <exact commands> -> <paths/shas, or "none">
web: <exact queries + date> -> <urls, or "none">
verdict: NEW | DELTA <one line> | DONE <path> <sha>
```

Repo search covers the whole checkout, not just the obvious directory:

- `git log --all --oneline -- <deliverable path>`
- `git log -S "<distinctive term>" --oneline`
- `grep -rn "<distinctive term>" . --include='*.md' --include='*.py' --include='*.c' --include='*.csv'`
- `docs/REPO-STATE-MAP.md` for the per-family verdict

Web search covers GitHub code (excluding `adineo-cmd/*`), XDA, LWN, HN, Reddit,
arXiv/Scholar, kernel source and linux-firmware.

- `DONE` -> close as ALREADY-DONE, do not work.
- `DELTA` -> work only the delta.
- `NEW` -> proceed.

No SEARCH comment, no work. A commit without one is a protocol violation.

## Discipline (all packages)

- RULE 0: search the web and GitHub code FIRST, record exact query strings and
  dates. Prior art found means find the delta or pick another device.
- RULE 1: fix stale counts, dangling links and broken references in the same
  session, respecting file walls; list before/after.
- Facts-not-blobs: never commit a proprietary payload. Hashes, sizes, offsets,
  counts and <=16-byte hex samples only.
- Standard-library Python only, run with `python3 -I`, no comments in code.
- Every number verified by command output before it is written.
- Honest negatives are deliverables. Report them; do not omit them.
- Push everything when done (Rule 3): verify, commit, fetch and rebase, push to
  `feat/open-device-site`, never force-push, never push `main`. A finished
  package with no remote commit is not done. Exception: issue #143 stays local.

## Task
Wire the full build and verify 382 pages and determinism.

## Scope
118+245+9+5+5 pages, byte-identical rebuild.

## Environment
The package is imported as `lib` (NEVER `site.lib` — `site` is a frozen stdlib module) with <repo>/site on sys.path. Tests run by direct path `python3 -I site/tests/test_x.py -v`. Standard library only, no comments.

## Acceptance
- Tests pass under `python3 -I`.
- Output deterministic; no third-party imports or network calls.
- Push when done (Rule 3).
title: Site: Wire the full build and verify 382 pages and determinism
